# Warrior classes

<!-- Generated by `coney-tools refs render` from research/references/warrior-classes.yaml. Do not edit. -->

The playable Warriors' stats: rage, the player's damage scale, button mashing, theft and mugging.
`CfgWarriorClass(class, ...)` fills a 14-byte record at `0x006b65c0 + class × 14`; a player's class is human `+0x1ba`,
picked by character type (`0x00222c20`): 0 Ajax, 1 Cleon, 2 Cochise, 3 Cowboy, 4 Fox, 5 Vermin, 6 Rembrandt and Ash,
7 Snow, 8 Swan, and 9 for every other type. Each difficulty script sets all nine; `config_preload2.lua` sets class 9
once at boot, and normal's at boot. The fields' readers: [Combat](../research/combat.md) and
[Characters: power classes](../research/characters.md#power-classes).

!!! info "What is complete"

    Every class each difficulty sets is listed with every argument (nine per difficulty and the boot class 9). Bytes
    `+0x05`, `+0x07`, `+0x09`, `+0x0a` and `+0x0d` are stored but their readers are not traced.

46 entries. Data: `research/references/warrior-classes.yaml`.

## Sources and evidence

Evidence levels used: confirmed-code.

- config_<difficulty>.lua, CfgWarriorClass

## Fields

| Field | Type | Hand-written | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | str | | `<difficulty>:<class>`. |
| `difficulty` | str | | The difficulty script that sets it (`boot`: `config_preload2.lua` only). |
| `class` | int | | Warrior class (`CfgWarriorClass`'s first argument; record `0x006b65c0 + class x 14`). |
| `warrior` | str | | Who gets it as a player. |
| `v05` | int | | Byte `+0x05`; not traced. |
| `damage_scale` | int | | Byte `+0x06`: the player's damage scale in percent. |
| `rage_max` | int | | 16-bit `+0x00`: the rage maximum. |
| `rage_gain` | int | | Byte `+0x02`: the rage gain percentage. |
| `rage_decay` | int | | Byte `+0x03`: idle rage decay (percent of the maximum per 20 s). |
| `rage_drain` | int | | Byte `+0x04`: rage drain while raging (percent of the maximum per 20 s). |
| `v07` | int | | Byte `+0x07` (1-3); not traced. |
| `mash` | int | | Byte `+0x08`: picks the button-mash gain factor. |
| `v09` | int | | Byte `+0x09` (1-3); not traced. |
| `v0a` | int | | Byte `+0x0a`; not traced. |
| `stereo_turns` | int | | Byte `+0x0b`: the car stereo theft's turns. |
| `mugging` | int | | Byte `+0x0c`: picks the mugging parameters. |
| `v0d` | int | | Byte `+0x0d`; not traced. |
| `power_class` | int | | The [power class](power-classes.md) the same Warriors get as a player. |
| `types` | list | | Character types that get this class as a player. |
| `source` | str | yes | Where the entry comes from: a script and binding, an address, a chunk. |
| `evidence` | str | yes | How we know: confirmed-code, confirmed-runtime, inferred or speculative ([evidence levels](../guides/research-workflow.md#evidence-levels)). |
| `notes` | str | yes | Our own short notes. |
